# ProSource Scientific

> > ProSource Scientific is a laboratory equipment and life sciences supplier offering PCR reagents, analytical instruments, lab consumables, and scientific supplies.

The company distributes products from leading manufacturers including Accuris, Globe Scientific, PSLabware, Ohaus, A&D, and MTC Bio. ProSource Scientific specializes in molecular biology reagents (Hot Start Taq, qPCR mixes, RT-qPCR kits), analytical balances, microplate readers, and general laboratory supplies for research and industrial applications.

## Key Topics

- Accuris Hot Start Taq DNA Polymerase
- Accuris qMAX Probe qPCR Mix
- Accuris SmartReader 96 microplate reader
- TaqMan probe-based detection
- Hot Start Taq polymerase
- Multiplex PCR and RT-qPCR kits
- Globe Scientific lab consumables
- PSLabware pipette tips
- Ohaus moisture balances
- Laboratory equipment and instruments
- PCR reagents and master mixes
- Optical filters for microplate readers
- One-step RT-qPCR kits
- ROX reference dye
- Scientific supplies and consumables

- [Accuris qMAX Probe One-Step Multiplex RT-qPCR Kits - PR2122-N-100](https://www.psscientific.com/accuris-qmax-probe-one-step-multiplex-rt-qpcr-kits-pr2122-n-100): Accuris qMAX One-Step Multiplex RT-qPCR Kit (PR2122-N-100) product page
